[Shot 1] At 00:00.000, cinematic live-action, Harry Potter film visual effects style, epic fantasy, post-apocalyptic wasteland. An extreme wide aerial shot from a black raven's POV soaring over a vast desolate canyon at twilight. Jagged rock formations tower on both sides, ancient crumbling ruins dot the canyon floor, ash-grey clouds swirl overhead. The raven's glossy black wings beat heavily in frame. The camera dives downward with large amplitude at fast speed, following the raven's descent toward a circular ancient stone arena at the canyon center. Hard cut.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the camera cuts to a dramatic low-angle medium-wide shot as the raven lands on a broken stone pillar in the foreground. The camera detaches from the raven and slowly pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed, framing both mages in the center. <Subject 1> stands on the left in her pristine dark silver-trimmed mage robe, her black cat-ear headband and long black hair visible against the wind, her face calm and focused, her sharp almond-shaped eyes locked on <Subject 2>. <Subject 2> stands on the right in his pristine grey hooded robe, his platinum blonde buzz cut catching the amber light, his face equally focused, his intense eyes meeting hers. Both raise their wands simultaneously. Wind sweeps dust and ash across the ancient stones. The sky churns with dark magical clouds. Keep <Subject 1>'s cat-ear headband and long black hair consistent. Keep <Subject 2>'s platinum buzz cut consistent. Hard cut.

[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the camera cuts to a medium tracking shot locked on both mages as they unleash their spells. <Subject 1> fires a brilliant blue-white beam from her wand, her face immediately showing fierce strain—sweat beading on her pale skin, sharp eyes narrowing, teeth gritted. <Subject 2> fires a blazing orange-red beam, his face equally strained with veins visible on his forehead. The two beams collide mid-air with a blinding flash and spherical explosion. Shockwaves ripple through raindrops. Their robes billow violently from the force, and the first tears appear—<Subject 1>'s skirt hem rips open, <Subject 2>'s left sleeve shreds. The camera tracks with medium amplitude at fast speed, keeping both fighters in frame. Ancient stone pillars behind them crack. Hard cut.

[Shot 4] At 00:10.000, the camera cuts to a medium-close tracking shot locked on <Subject 1> as she channels a devastating golden-white spell. Her dark robe is now heavily torn—skirt shredded, right shoulder ripped exposing pale skin, sleeves tattered. Her face shows extreme determination mixed with pain: the left cheek bleeds slightly, dirt and sweat streak her pale skin, her sharp eyes burn with golden magical light, her black cat-ear headband charred at one ear but still in place. <Subject 2> is visible in the background, his grey robe burning at the edges, his face showing terror as his orange beam is pushed back toward him. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed on <Subject 1>'s warrior-like expression. Hard cut.

[Shot 5] At 00:12.500, the camera cuts to a wide shot as <Subject 1>'s golden beam completely consumes <Subject 2>'s magic and explodes. The blast throws <Subject 2> backward across the wet stones, his destroyed grey robe flailing, his body tumbling before crashing into a broken pillar and sliding down motionless. His platinum buzz cut is visible, his face showing unconsciousness. The camera holds static for the explosion peak, capturing golden-white shockwaves rippling across the destroyed canyon. Hard cut.

[Shot 6] At 00:13.500, the camera cuts to a medium shot on <Subject 1> standing alone in the center of the cratered arena. Her dark robe is in ruins, charred edges smoking gently, silver trim blackened. She lowers her wand, her arm trembling from exhaustion. Her face shows profound relief mixed with pain—the cheek wound still bleeds, dirt and ash streak her pale skin, her sharp eyes are half-lidded with fatigue, but the corner of her mouth shows a faint smile of victory. Her black cat-ear headband is damaged but still on her head. Rain falls on her, creating steam where it hits the scorched ground. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed. Hard cut.

[Shot 7] At 00:14.500, the camera cuts to a low-angle extreme wide shot as the black raven takes flight from the broken pillar, wings spreading wide. The camera attaches to the raven's POV and pulls upward with large amplitude at slow speed, rising above <Subject 1>'s solitary figure. She stands small but triumphant in the center of the vast destroyed canyon, her ruined robe fluttering, the destroyed arena and collapsed canyon walls spreading out in all directions. The shot ends with <Subject 1> as a lone silhouette against the stormy twilight sky, victorious.
